description: This file defines the PermissionsPerBundle class, a Drupal plugin that manages permission assignments per bundle for user roles, including creation, application, and parsing of permission configurations.

classes.name: PermissionsPerBundle
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that grants permissions to roles based on bundles, with methods for creation, application, and parsing permission values.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting configuration manager, entity type bundle info, and target entity type.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the plugin with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies permission templates to a role based on configuration, handling bundle exclusions.

methods.name: parseValue
methods.description: Parses the input value into permissions and excluded bundles arrays.
